bio: When Incumbents Lead the Climate Transition "Tushman’s research on ambidexterity and organizational renewal argues that incumbents succeed in moments of disruption when they can exploit their existing business while exploring the new one."--BiGS' Amram Migdal on a course with Professors Trumbull and Tushman.
